basis_note: Every number in this file is a planning ceiling chosen by a human, not an observed cost. MellyCore has never run a loop and therefore has no measured token spend. The estimate-cost command labels its output the same way. A value may only be described as measured when it comes from a run ledger iteration with tokens.measured = true.

global.paused_note: Operator-controlled soft pause. When true, every loop must stop even if the kill switch file is absent.
global.max_parallel_loops_note: One loop at a time in Phase 1. Concurrency is a collision risk that Phase 1 does not attempt to manage.

estimation_model.note: Inputs to the deterministic estimator in scripts/loop_ops/cost.py. Adjusting these changes estimates only; they never become measured figures.

no_op.description: Loop starts, reads state, finds nothing to do, exits.

report.description: Loop reads its declared scope and writes findings to a report. This is the only scenario Phase 1 actually authorizes.

assisted_action.description: Hypothetical: loop proposes a change behind a human gate. Not authorized in Phase 1. Estimated for planning only.

realistic_mix.description: A realistic estimate assumes most runs find nothing and a minority produce a full report. Weights must sum to 1.0.

maker_checker.description: An independent verifier re-reads the work. Applied when a loop sets verifier_required = true. Roughly doubles cost, which is the price of not letting an agent grade its own homework.

parallel_agents_default.description: Phase 1 runs one agent. A caller may pass a higher multiplier to model a hypothetical fan-out.
